name: RC-B10-0533/2025 – After recital B – Am 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of the war and the humanitarian catastrophe in Sudan
part_text: Ba. whereas the EU and several of its Member States have for decades maintained political, economic and security partnerships with successive Sudanese regimes, including during periods marked by grave violations in Darfur and other marginalised regions; whereas such relations – including training, technical assistance, migration control arrangements and externalised border management programmes – have in some cases contributed to the empowerment of military, intelligence and paramilitary structures later involved in atrocities;
